title: Sonaselection India IPO Details
intro:
Sonaselection India IPO is a book build issue of ₹141.57 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.43 crore shares of ₹141.57 crore.

Sonaselection India IPO opens for subscription on Sep 17, 2026 and closes on Sep 21, 2026. The allotment for the Sonaselection India IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 22, 2026. Sonaselection India IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 24, 2026.

Sonaselection India IPO is set issue price band at ₹94 to ₹99 per share. The lot size for an application is 150 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,850 (150 shares) (based on upper price).

Choice Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Sonaselection India IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in February 2022, the Company is an integrated fabric manufacturing and processing company engaged in the production of value-added textile products. It manufactures 100% cotton fabric, cotton lycra (stretch) fabric, cotton blends and polyester blends, and also undertakes processing of 100% cotton, cotton blends, polyester-viscose (P/V) and polyester fabrics. The Company transitioned from a job-work based processing model to a manufacturing-led model after acquiring an established textile processing unit in 2022 and subsequently commissioned a cotton fabric processing plant in July 2024.

The Company's manufacturing facility is located in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, spread across approximately 49,540 sq. metres, with an installed processing capacity of 82.44 million metres per annum. The facility is equipped with modern textile processing machinery and undertakes key processes including bleaching, dyeing and finishing. The Company follows an integrated operating model combining own manufacturing and job-work processing, enabling it to manage processing activities, quality control, grading, packing and outbound logistics while serving customers according to their technical and product specifications.

The Company's product portfolio primarily comprises 100% cotton fabrics, cotton lycra (stretch) fabrics, cotton blends and polyester blends, catering to varied apparel and textile applications. It also undertakes processing of greige fabric supplied by customers on a job-work basis. Through its diversified product portfolio, modern manufacturing infrastructure and quality-focused processes, the Company aims to provide consistent quality, cost-efficient solutions and timely deliveries to its customers.

As of July 31, 2026, the Company had 979 employees, including personnel across production, plant maintenance, dispatch and supply chain, quality assurance, safety and security, accounts and finance, sales and marketing, and other support functions.
strengths: Healthy track record and steady growth.
Strong customer relationships and high customer retention.
Strategically located manufacturing facility with modern technology.
Experienced Promoters supported by a professional management team.
Integrated business model combining manufacturing and job-work activities.

faqs.question: How to apply in Sonaselection India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Sonaselection India IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Sonaselection India IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Sonaselection India IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Sonaselection India IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: You can apply in Sonaselection India IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
